text:
GENERATE BURST CA-est-B — Run C-9 cathedral ESTABLISHING IMAGE, register arm B (Illuminated) (Matt R-C9-38: cathedral work in parallel; material for his sitting on arena layout / pools / world beyond the walls). task_id "CA-est-B".

One 1536x1024 painted OVERVIEW of the ENTIRE arena and its surroundings, composed as our fixed game camera would see it if it could pull back: elevated three-quarter view, about 53 degrees down, north is screen-up, parallel projection (no vanishing point). IMAGE 1 is the geometry guide of the whole floor plate at this scale; the outline is a SUGGESTION — the art decides where walls and structures go; keep the overall footprint, the islands and pools roughly where the guide puts them.
THE BUILDING (identity by qualities, never names): a fortress-cathedral of a crusading order that held a border against hell and lost it THIS WEEK: mass before grace — enormous piers, Romanesque weight with gothic verticals, cold grey-white and black dressed stone, iron only where structural. A faith of the SUN and the CHAIN. Its floor is smooth and beautiful; the violence is local and legible (cracks follow joints, only where something fell or blew).
THE LAYOUT (north = up, as ruled): the player ENTERS from the SOUTH through the shattered façade, up the road from the crag. The long NAVE runs north with arcades of piers left and right; TRANSEPTS east and west; the CHANCEL and raised dais at the north end. The demon-gate BLAST crater is at the CROSSING, mid-nave, between the player and the altar, a little OFF-CENTRE; the exact CENTRE of the floor stays clear and smooth (a great fallen stained-glass window will lie there later as an object). The arena is a FUNNEL TO THE MIDDLE: every entrance is a ONE-WAY broken stair or breach the monsters leap and the player cannot cross, with a HAZARD APRON on the playable side: (1) EAST — a crater into the crypt with COLD BLUE FIRE at its mouth, and a broken GALLERY STAIR above it where enemies come DOWN from an upper level; (2) WEST — the wall breached from outside by siege, the sunset flooding in; (3) NORTH — the chancel breached; (4) one FIRE entrance where real orange fire burns across the threshold (the near ambush). The order's fire is WARM; what comes from below is COLD — the only saturated cold is demonic. The four islands in the guide are bases of fallen piers; the six hatched discs are pools of burning pitch seeping through broken flagstones.
BARE SCENE RULE: paint ONLY architecture, ground and the world beyond the walls — no furniture, pews, statues, candles, bodies, banners, gates or rubble props (added later as objects).
BEYOND THE WALLS: through the west breach and the broken apse, the valley at sunset, the burning forest, and far off the Keepers' tower.
STYLE: IGNORE the register card's manuscript clauses for this arm ONLY in favour of the level's EXISTING hand-drawn painted register shown in IMAGE 2 (a painted chunk of this same interior: confident dark contour, painted planes, restrained texture) — match it exactly; keep the card's camera, plate and forbidden-names rules.
No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Two image_gen calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the camera is not the elevated overview, the entrances/crater/centre are missing or misplaced, props appear, or text appears — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/CA-est-B_a.png and out/CA-est-B_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CA-est-B"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — geometry guide of the whole floor plate (outline = suggestion)
IMAGE 2 — this level's approved painted-book hand (line, hatching, washes)
IMAGE 3 — the approved dark sunset mood and purple haze (colour only)
